source.fit_validation_policy: Deterministic whole-story 90/10 split of the 2,000 training stories; official test is parsed without labels and remains sealed.

partitions.ordering: SHA-256 rank by fixed seed and story ID; retain source order within each phase; no story splitting.
partitions.warm_online_policy: Per-seed deterministic SHA-256 whole-story assignment; HLA and HLB share the same 1,440/360 assignment for each seed. The 10 seed partitions are separately hashed in the manifest.

targets.L0: mention-to-entity binding from source-only observations and conservative weak targets
targets.L1: typed corefers_with relation target; official validation edge gold unavailable
targets.answer: separate location-answer forecast; answer and witness scoring only after prediction decisions are frozen
targets.weak_supervision: Pronoun target only for exactly one distinct compatible prior named entity; ambiguous/unresolved pronouns abstain; no cross-story binding.

architecture_specific_prediction.HLA: Answer transition is read from the learned ContextTransitionLearner conditioned on task11:entity:<entity>:from:<previous-location>.
architecture_specific_prediction.HLB: Answer transition is read from typed task11_location_transition records in HLBAdapter's rollback-scoped canonical model store; derived targets are inserted with observe(), never observe_source(), and never enter the immutable source evidence journal.
architecture_specific_prediction.common: Both architectures use the same source observations and conservative prior-only weak binding rule. Official answer/support labels remain evaluator-only.

baselines.policy: Compare every HLA/HLB full-learning seed on the exact same validation queries; oracle upper bounds excluded; do not relax thresholds to force candidate selection.

experimental_design.run_order: Stable lexicographic architecture, condition, seed order before deterministic sharding.
experimental_design.pairing: HLA and HLB use identical source story order, seed, phase assignment, event features, query order and forecast cutoffs.
experimental_design.reset: Every run unit starts from a clean adapter, native runtime and learner; no state crosses seeds, conditions or architectures.

conditions.full_learning: All four H1 error channels enabled.
conditions.no_temporal: Disable temporal eligibility/credit and L0 feature-predictor updates only.
conditions.no_relational: Disable L1 semantic relation/coreference updates only.
conditions.no_abstraction: Disable L2 context and event-role abstraction updates only.
conditions.no_task: Disable task-answer reliability calibration; this is a predeclared placebo/negative-control condition because Task 11 has no independent task-outcome training target under the evaluator-label firewall. Do not interpret it as a task-channel causal ablation.
conditions.no_learning: Disable all learning updates; preserve source ingestion, inference, forecasts and scoring.

candidate_selection.candidates: full_learning only; five ablations remain comparative conditions
candidate_selection.ranking: Highest answer exact match, then highest support-witness recall, then lowest seed.
candidate_selection.failure: If no seed meets all integrity and baseline thresholds, select no candidate.

answer_metric_expectations.no_temporal: Expected invariant to full_learning answer metrics: Task 11 answer head consumes the L2 context-transition model, not temporal eligibility/credit or the L0 feature predictor.
answer_metric_expectations.no_relational: Expected invariant to full_learning answer metrics: the answer head consumes conservative source-only weak bindings and L2 transitions, not the L1 semantic relation/coreference learner.
answer_metric_expectations.no_task: Expected invariant to full_learning answer metrics and retained as a placebo: no independent Task 11 task-outcome training target is available under the evaluator-label firewall.
answer_metric_expectations.no_abstraction: Expected zero forecast coverage because the L2 answer-transition model is disabled.
answer_metric_expectations.no_learning: Expected zero forecast coverage because all learning updates are disabled.

metrics.aggregation: Per-seed/per-condition raw counts plus story-clustered paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, 95% intervals). No pooled cross-task metric.

performance.answer_exact_match: At least 1.0 on the frozen validation split to match the strongest non-oracle baseline; if unattainable, no candidate is selected.

resource_preflight.design: Full 1,800-story fit path (1,440 warm-start + 360 online) and 200-story read-only validation for HLA/HLB under full_learning and no_learning.
resource_preflight.retry_policy: At most two retries for a failed preflight unit; preserve failed-attempt logs and never overwrite successful evidence.
resource_preflight.pass_rule: All four reserved-seed units complete; exact partition and label-isolation checks pass; all resource ceilings remain within limits; resource budget is archived before the 120-unit campaign.

sharding.retry: Retry only failed run-unit keys; completed artifacts immutable and reused by exact key and digest.
sharding.aggregate_gate: Exactly 120 unique keys, no duplicate/missing/mixed-manifest unit, all required metrics and hashes present.

artifacts.provenance: Bind every artifact to source, phase, run key, architecture, condition, seed, code commit, native commit, protocol hash and partition hash.

confirmatory.dataset_role: Separate generated challenge; not official bAbI test and not used for fit, online adaptation, validation, threshold tuning or candidate selection.
confirmatory.construction: Task 11 only; two distinct named anchors with disjoint novel names per story, explicit location changes, pronoun mentions with exactly one compatible antecedent, and a predeclared ambiguous/unresolved subset that must abstain. Keep generated input JSONL and evaluator label JSONL as separate files with independent SHA-256 hashes.
confirmatory.execution: After validation candidate selection only; evaluate selected HLA and HLB candidate once each. No tuning or candidate reselection from confirmatory results.
confirmatory.generator: generate_task11_confirmatory; inputs and evaluator labels are separate JSONL files; generated only after validation candidate selection.

required_before_launch: Full repository and Task 11 prediction/evaluation contract CI green, including confirmatory generator and label-separation tests.
Task 11 non-oracle baseline validation archived and reviewed.
This Task 11-only 120-unit protocol and whole-story manifest tests pass.
Full-scale reserved-seed resource preflight passes and its measured budget is archived.
No Task 14/19 or frozen Task 3/5 source or campaign work is included.
execution_gate.freeze_boundary: Protocol freeze and campaign execution authorization are distinct. The workflow runs the full repository/Task 11 contract suite first, then the full-scale reserved-seed preflight. The campaign starts only if both pass; campaign-unit authorization remains false until the preflight acceptance job succeeds. The generated confirmatory challenge is produced only after validation-only candidate selection; its evaluator labels are opened only after all selected candidate predictions are frozen.
execution_gate.launch_allowed_meaning: The gated workflow may execute contract tests and the reserved-seed full-scale preflight. This does not authorize any of the 120 campaign units; campaign_units_authorized remains false until the preflight acceptance job succeeds.

native_runtime.kernel: Reuse the exact H0 kernel configuration from the accepted Task 11 persistent-resource qualification: gamma=reverse(SOEMemory.decay_rates), w=0.25 per channel, linear_decay=0.05 per state coordinate, forcing_bias=0.
native_runtime.top_down_gain_rationale: Native commit ddf424b0ab8eb23329cd51256a919beeae2ee288 is built on the persistent-hierarchy runtime line (base commit 2539df6bda7ef3c9dd7c707abe26eff8bdbb59de), preserving create_persistent_hierarchy_runtime. It saturates mean-absolute top-down observable drive with tanh, uses stable log-sum-exp weight normalization, rejects non-finite modulation ranges, and caps gain magnitude at 50. H0 gain 1.0 is therefore restored without unbounded exponential modulation. Native CI passed on Linux and Windows for C++ and Python; full-scale Task 11 preflight on this exact pin remains mandatory.
